g.text: Query recent message history for current conversation ID
Return last 10 messages with role tags and timestamps
Assemble memory context window from conversation history
Filter out obsolete tool calls andtruncate messages exceeding tokenlimits
Inject persistent user profile andpreferences summary
Return sanitized multi-turn conversation memory block
Forward prompt payload with assembled memory context to AI Service
Structured memory assembly preserves context continuity while staying strictly within LLM context budget
